title: Taffou 2014 rear-field dog/sheep looming PPS
citation: Taffou, M., & Viaud-Delmon, I. (2014). Cynophobic Fear Adaptively Extends Peri-Personal Space. Frontiers in Psychiatry, 5, 122.
notes: Rear hemi-field binaural looming dog/sheep design. The GUI expands the reported rear-left and rear-right paths into separate source assets, but exact dog/sheep source audio and LISTEN-HRTF rendering are not bundled.

tactile_stimulus.site: palmar surface of the left index finger

reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: 224 tactile-target trials (2 sound types x 2 hemispaces x 7 tactile timings x 8 repetitions) plus 32 auditory-only catch trials = 256 trials split equally into eight 32-trial blocks.
reference_parameters.profile_reaudit_2026_07_15: Publisher HTML methods report both rear-left and rear-right trajectories at -135 and +135 degrees; the current preload cabinet already expands these as separate assets, so rear hemifield direction is no longer a toolkit structural blocker.
implementation_gaps: exact dog/sheep source audio and Audacity amplitude/dynamic matching settings
LISTEN HRTF subject/filter identifier and renderer settings

provenance.source: Frontiers methods report dog growling/sheep bleating, 3000 ms sounds, 44.1 kHz, binaural rendering with non-individual LISTEN HRTFs.
Frontiers methods report T1-T5 at 0, 750, 1500, 2250, and 3000 ms from sound onset, 224 tactile trials and 32 catch trials.
